items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: The mention of 'Manuel Paul' occurs only in the interviewer's meta-commentary: 'We better stop here, we got to do a little with Manuel Paul.' The interviewee does not speak about Manuel Paul, nor is there any narrative evidence of a personal or professional relationship between the interviewee and M

ctx.x: I was a regular member in John's band. Yeah. Yeah, I just got out after them fellas man, that fellas that like the auger too much, you know what I mean? Had a fella that he like the auger, man and Gabbert, he said, I like the auger so much, you know. So, I got this guy, me and this boy Albert, you know. Told me Albert's son. Yeah, Lutcher. Lutcher. So, we got out. Not, he was playing with him, and Remus Maschews, Bill Maschews, brother, you know. So, Remus told me one day when he was coming across, he said, you…

We better stop here, we got to do a little with Manuel Paul. Yeah, yeah, yeah. So, thank you very much. Okay. Okay, what's your name? Emmanuel Paul. Yeah, where were you born? In New Orleans, Louisiana. Mm-hmm. And, uh, excuse me. Oh, God, I'm sorry. Uh, what year? Time, exactly. Ah, February the 2nd, 1904. Mm-hmm. Uh, did anybody in your family play music? No, no one in the family. Mm-hmm. Well, how'd you get interested in it? Well, through friends. As a youngster? As a youngster, in my teenage. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.…
